common: Use case: illustration-story. Create an ORIGINAL Dreamerie spot-the-difference painting, full-bleed 1672x941 landscape or larger identical aspect. Images 1 and 2 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: textured hand-painted gouache, visible paper/brush strokes, elegant illustrative detail, rich colors and impossible dream logic. NEW composition with its specified palette, NOT the reference palette. Surreal, somewhat abstract, emotionally expressive: metamorphosis, unexpected scale and poetic visual contradictions. Recognizable objects amid abstract forms, clear enough to inspect. Avoid photorealism, rendered/plastic lighting, ordinary holiday greeting cards, generic cute animal scenes, repetitive golden sunsets, dense visual noise. PG only: no gore, violence, injury, disturbing body horror, sexual imagery or real politicians. No text, letters, numerals, borders, labels or watermarks. One original painting, not a pair. Keep the five named clue props visible, separate and inside the frame.

originals.new-years: Mood: hopeful uncertainty; ice turquoise, vermilion and cream. A curious boxy ROBOT hatches from a huge broken hourglass, its shadow still asleep inside the unbroken lower bulb; staircases unfold from a blank calendar like paper accordions into an upside-down city. Painterly mechanical absurdity, no readable numbers. Five clear separate props: robot's large chest hatch is RED; its left antenna ends in a SQUARE; foreground clock has TWO hands; a little blue toolbox has THREE rivets along its front; a cream paper plane upper right has a GREEN tail stripe.
originals.mlk: Mood: courageous hope and belonging; cobalt, coral, cream, deep plum. A vast ribbon bridge knots two mismatched puzzle-piece islands together in empty blue space; doors of different shapes stand open without walls, stairways turn into migrating doves, the far horizon is folded like cloth. No portraits or slogans. Five readable details: central bridge knot is GOLD, left door has a ROUND window, one foreground white dove holds a THREE-leaf olive twig, right door's brass handle is a STAR, foreground violet ribbon spool has TWO small white dots. Dignified abstract dream of connection, not a literal ceremony.
originals.valentines: Mood: tender longing and romantic absurdity; raspberry, deep turquoise and dusty cream. A MERMAID in a red coat swims through a floating TELEVISION containing an ocean, reaching toward a tiny astronaut inside an oversized glass teacup; a staircase made of envelopes connects incompatible worlds. Original poetic PG affection, not a pinup; mermaid fully clothed torso and stylized fish tail. Five clear details: television frame is BLUE, astronaut's visor is GOLD, largest envelope has a HEART-shaped red seal, television has TWO round control knobs, mermaid's coat has THREE white buttons.
originals.presidents: Mood: puzzled and intellectually curious; ochre, navy, mint. A colossal vintage COMPUTER contains an endless library; its keyboard keys have become stairs for dignified abstract CHESS PIECES, while a tiny door in a floating book leads back into the screen. No real politicians or labels. Five distinct details: computer housing is CORAL, largest chess rook has THREE battlements, foreground book's clasp is a CRESCENT, mouse cable is COILED into a visible spiral, small green floppy disk lower right has a ROUND metal shutter opening. Dream of impossible civic stories, not realism.
originals.st-patricks: Mood: comically furious bad luck, mischievous; bottle green, acid yellow and lilac. A fuzzy lime MONSTER with a hilariously annoyed face is too large to fit beneath a tiny inside-out umbrella; its rain falls upward and a rainbow is tied in a knot around a floating boot. A shamrock-shaped island hangs upside down in the distance. PG creature, no threat, no leprechaun stereotypes. Five details: umbrella canopy is ORANGE; monster has TWO short purple horns; foreground teapot has a SQUARE handle; yellow rainboot has TWO buckles; a small copper coin on a rock has a TRIANGLE hole.
originals.easter: Mood: surprised and curious, slightly uncanny; lavender, lemon, coral. A three-eyed friendly ALIEN has hatched from an enormous decorated egg that contains a miniature galaxy; its tiny flying saucer is upside down in a rabbit-shaped crater, carrots levitate like antennae, the horizon folds into an eggshell. Five separated readable details: giant egg has a BLUE zigzag band; alien has THREE eyes; saucer has TWO antennae; foreground pink egg has THREE yellow dots; one floating carrot upper right has TWO green leaves. Whimsical painterly sci-fi Easter, not an ordinary garden.
originals.mothers: Mood: tender protection; rose, sea-glass and midnight teal. A giant gentle knitted MONSTER with long mitten-like arms cradles a tiny sleeping HOUSE as though it were a baby. Its wool unravels into rivers and the hills are folded quilts; a thimble contains a miniature storm that cannot escape. Five details: monster's large belly patch is GOLD with a STAR shape; little house roof is BLUE; foreground thimble has THREE holes near rim; rose teacup has a CRESCENT handle; small spool at right has TWO ivory stripes. Strange protective dream, no literal family portrait.
originals.memorial: Mood: quiet grief, remembrance and peace; slate blue, dusty white, muted poppy red, NO golden sunset. An EMPTY chair floats above a still sea; its reflection is an enormous folded paper bird. Poppies grow from tiny boats that drift up into a soft impossible horizon, a distant stairway ends in empty sky. Respectful and contemplative, no graves or weapons. Five details: chair's draped scarf is CREAM, foreground lantern has a CRESCENT window, one large foreground poppy has TWO leaves on its stem, a blue paper boat at right has a WHITE star seal, a little smooth gray stone lower center has THREE dark holes. Wide negative space, emotion through absence, surreal symbolism.
originals.juneteenth: Mood: joyous freedom, release and possibility; brilliant coral, turquoise, sunshine yellow with deep ink accents. A giant open brass LOCK is not restraining anything: it has become an arch from which hundreds of tiny abstract flowers rise into the shape of a bird. A ribbon road unrolls from an OPEN book into sky; two small human silhouettes dance on separate floating stair treads, symbolic not realistic. Five readable details: giant lock's keyhole is HEART-shaped, a foreground kite is GREEN with a RED bow on its string, an ivory jug at right has THREE cobalt stripes, a small sunflower foreground has a BLUE center, a floating small brass key upper right has TWO teeth. No chains, suffering, slavery reenactments or stereotypes. Original exuberant surrealism.
originals.fathers: Mood: affectionate ridiculousness and playful pride; orange, cobalt, pale lime. A tiny COWBOY rides an enormous wooden rocking chair, trying to lasso a runaway DOORWAY; his hat's shadow is a gigantic whale. A teacup sails through dry geometric clouds. PG whimsical cowboy, NO weapons. Five details: cowboy's neckerchief is RED; chair's backrest has a STAR cutout; floating door has TWO hinges; teacup boat has a TRIANGULAR blue sail; foreground boot has THREE brass studs. Impossible scale and expressive gestures, no realistic desert scene.
originals.independence: Mood: wild joy, energetic astonishment; midnight blue, scarlet, electric turquoise. A jubilant ROBOT on roller skates pulls an enormous zipper in the sky and PAPER FIREWORKS tumble out as geometric stars; the ocean hangs overhead and a miniature town rests upside down on a red picnic plate. No flags or weapons. Five clear details: robot's chest panel is GOLD; left skate has THREE wheels; largest paper star has FIVE points; foreground red picnic jug has a ROUND handle; small silver bell lower right has TWO slits. Strong surreal painterly shapes, not a literal parade.
originals.labor: Mood: comically frustrated determination; brick red, indigo and mustard. A cranky old COMPUTER with a simple frowning face is trying to knit an endless KEYBOARD scarf; its mouse has grown ridiculous little legs and escaped across a ladder that bends into a knot. Floating gears sprout from a toolbox, perspective deliberately impossible. Five details: computer housing is TEAL; big gear foreground has a STAR-shaped center hole; red cable spool has TWO gold bands; bent ladder has ONE blue middle rung; little mouse has THREE feet. No text on keys or screen, no violence, crisp inspectable mechanical details.
originals.october-observance: Mood: awe, mystery, gentle loneliness; cedar green, rust, glacier blue. A gigantic floating TURTLE whose shell is a forest carries a river that pours UP into a stone arch; the turtle's shadow is a mountain range disconnected below. Abstract ancient-land symbolism, no people, costumes, sacred motifs or colonial imagery. Five details: stone arch opening is HEART-shaped; foreground autumn leaf has THREE dew drops; turtle has a BLUE cheek marking; small pale flower at left has SIX petals; spiral shell lower right has a GOLD tip. Elegant fantastical nature rather than a normal landscape.
originals.halloween: Mood: spooky and deliciously apprehensive; inky purple, cold jade, pumpkin orange. A huge shaggy MONSTER made of shadows peeks around a tiny crooked house suspended from a key; its own shadow is a frightened little sock. A floating pumpkin opens like a door onto an impossible hallway, chairs cling upside down to the roof. PG eerie expressive monster with big eyes, no teeth or violence, not a jump scare. Five details: house's round window has a VERTICAL divider; pumpkin has a STAR-shaped eye; foreground lantern glows GREEN; small purple boot has TWO brass buckles; monster has THREE little orange horns. Crisp beautiful brushwork and strange geometry.
originals.veterans: Mood: homesick yearning turning toward relief; washed blue, muted russet, warm ivory with one amber light. An enormous EMPTY travelling coat floats beside a doorway containing a tiny distant home; a long road loops through the coat's sleeve and comes back as a ribbon. A suitcase casts the shadow of a tree; a single poppy faces away from the sun. Respectful symbolic homecoming, no people, battle, graves, weapons or medals. Five details: coat has THREE gold buttons, doorway's handle is a CRESCENT, brown suitcase has a GREEN diamond patch, small blue teacup lower right has a RED handle, paper bird upper left has a BLUE tail. Painterly impossible geography, atmosphere of longing.
originals.thanksgiving: Mood: belly-laugh abundance and gratitude; russet, aubergine, orange and cream. A fully clothed MERMAID CHEF in a modest apron floats above an impossibly spiralling banquet table, stirring a PIE PLANET with a giant spoon; empty plates hold tiny forests, a pear wears a chair as a hat. Elegant surreal feast, no literal diners. Five details: chef's apron is BLUE; pie crust has a STAR cutout; foreground napkin has THREE cream diamonds; plum teapot has TWO loop handles; small spoon lower right has a HEART finial. Funny dream logic and inspectable details.
originals.christmas: Mood: hushed wonder and secret mischievous delight; midnight teal, mint and frosted rose. A tiny friendly NINJA in a quilted winter suit and soft mask is stealthily wrapping a GIANT CLOUD as a present; their long scarf becomes a gift ribbon and stairs of empty stockings lead through a glass ornament into nowhere. Only eyes visible, no weapons or fighting. Five details: cloud's gift ribbon is GREEN; ninja's scarf is RED; ornament hanging loop is a STAR; large stocking has a CREAM heel; small silver bell lower left has TWO slits. Painterly surreal winter, not ordinary Santa village.
originals.new-years-eve: Mood: theatrical nervous excitement before midnight; black plum, magenta, pewter and lemon. A friendly one-eyed ALIEN DJ spins an enormous pocketwatch as a turntable, while a ribbon of time unwinds into a tiny upside-down ballroom; dancing chairs have no people, a doorway stands on a clock hand. Five details: alien's headphones are BLUE; giant watch has TWO hands; foreground party hat has THREE diamonds; small speaker at right has a SQUARE grille; floating silver spoon upper left has a RED bow. No text, numbers, alcohol or scary violence. Elegant weird sci-fi celebration.
